summary: Guarded three-object teardown helper (structural twin of ObjectAllocator 0045bb90). Dereferences up to three pointer slots a1/a2/a3 into v6/v4/v5, partially resets the first object via LargeStructPartialReset, then delegates each non-null object through GuardedDelegate and zeroes its slot; returns the last assigned value (the first dereferenced value of a1 if nothing else ran).

local_names.a1: slot 1 pointer; dereferenced into v6 and zeroed after delegate
local_names.a2: slot 2 pointer; dereferenced into v4 and zeroed after delegate
local_names.a3: slot 3 pointer; dereferenced into v5 and zeroed after delegate

operations.description: If a1 is non-null, read the first dword of *a1 into v6.
If a2 is non-null, read the first dword of *a2 into v4.
If a3 is non-null, read the first dword of *a3 into v5.
If v6 is non-zero, call LargeStructPartialReset(v6, v4, v5) to partially reset the first object using all three cached values.
If v4 is non-zero, call GuardedDelegate(v4).
If v4 is non-zero, clear the first dword at a2 to 0.
If v5 is non-zero, call GuardedDelegate(v5).
If v5 is non-zero, clear the first dword at a3 to 0.
If v6 is non-zero, call GuardedDelegate(v6).
If v6 is non-zero, clear the first dword at a1 to 0.
Return the accumulated result, initially the address of a1.

unresolved: Relationship between the three objects and the meaning of LargeStructPartialReset's three-argument shape is inferred from the structural twin, not proven.
